Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS : 10729 -1983 




Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
NAIL SET. KUNTSCHER 



( Reaffirmed 2005 ) 



1. Scope — Prescribes dimensional and other requirements for Kuntscher nail set used in orthopaedic 
surgery. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 



P^T 



m 



-260- 



AM dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 NAIL SET, KUNTSCHER 



2.1 Deviations shall be permitted on dimensions as indicated below: 
± 0'5 mm on dimensions below 5 mm 
zb I'O mm on dimensions ^bove 5 and up to 10 mm 
± V5 mm on dimensions above 1 and up to 50 mm 
± 2'0 mm on dimensions above 50 and up to 100 mm 
± 3'0 mm on dimensions above 100 and up to 200 mm 
± 5'0 mm on dimensions above 200 mm 

3. Material —Stainless steel conforming to designation 30Cr13 of IS : 6603-1972 'Specification for 
stainless steel bars and flats'. 



4. Heat Treatment 

to 470 HV, 



The nail set shall be evenly hardened and tempered to give a hardness of 420 
Nail set shall be free from pits, burrs, cracks, seams and other surface 



5. Workmanship and Finish 

flaws. 

5.1 The instrument shall be electro-polished and passivated. 

5.2 For proper grip the handle shall be suitably knurled. 

6. Corrosion Resistance Test — Test the instrument in accordance with IS : 7531-1975 'Method for 
boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel surgical instruments'. The 
instrument shall not show any sign of corrosion after the test. 

7. Marking — The instrument shall be clearly and legibly marked with the manufacturer's name or initial 
or recognized trade-mark and with the words 'Stainless Steel'. 

7.1 ISI Certification l\/larl<ing — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



Adopted 15 November 1983
